items.text: The first playable Super Bugs have joined the fight and the Museum of Super Natural History has opened its doors in the Super Natural Update!

Fishing and bug catching have received their biggest update yet, with the new museum for your bug collection, functional aquarium tanks at Super Sea Land, a day-night cycle in the Social Hub alongside new critters and catching tools.
And competition gets fiercer too with the new Bullpup burst rifle joining the rotating weapon lineup alongside SAW vs. Rebellion updates including a new Merc class and class helmets.
The Museum of Super Natural History and functional aquarium tanks display your bug and fish collections
First-ever playable Super Bugs arrive: Super Moths & Ants
Day-Night Cycles arrive in the Social Hub, with certain fish and bugs appearing only at specific times
30+ new bugs and fish to catch
Bug Detectors and Fish Food help you track down nearby bugs and improve fishing pools for everyone nearby
The Super Natural Pass brings cosmetics themed around bugs, fish and nature, while the Super Natural Starter Pack includes the Super Luna Moth and unlocks Super Moths early in the Research Lab
The Bullpup, a new burst rifle, joins the rotating weapon lineup with enough bark to match its bite
Uzis & Dualzis permanently join the weapon pool
SAW vs. Rebellion receives the new Merc class, custom class helmets, smarter bots, and more quality-of-life improvements
The New Chat Experience (Beta) on PC lets you message Discord friends directly between SAR and Discord, alongside a fully redesigned in-game chat box

There’s a lot packed into this update, and the trailer above gives you the quick tour. We also invited SAR Content Creators to explore it early, so you can watch their first reactions to everything new here:
Now, let’s stay a while and take a gander at everything in the Super Natural Update!

The Museum of Super Natural History has finally opened its doors after months of beaver construction! This new point of interest is more than just a staging ground for your gunfights. Its exhibits let you show off your bug collection, and when you’re in a party, you can view your friends’ collections too!
But what about the fish?

Super Sea Land’s aquarium tanks are now fully functional, displaying your fish collection or the collections of your friends. We’ve wanted to bring these tanks to life ever since we first added Super Sea Land in the Sea Legs Update years ago, so we’re super excited to see them swimming with your very own fish at last!

The Bright Future Starter Pack and Alien Overlord Starter Pack will also remain available for one more week before going into the vault.
The Social Hub and collecting are getting a lot of quality of life additions this update!

The Social Hub now has a (Super) natural Day-Night Cycle! Along with bringing new ambience to the island, certain fish and bugs only appear during the day or at night. Many NPCs and Mini Animals will even settle in for some sleep after dark, but you can still wake NPCs up to chat or continue their quests. All “come back tomorrow” quests now reset with the next in-game morning too, rather than making you wait a full real-world day!

You might be wondering: will this come to other game modes? The short answer is that we’re not sure yet, but it’s possible, and we’d love to hear what you think after trying it in the Social Hub. For now, matches will still be set during either the day or night from the beginning of each round, but let us know if you’d like us to explore bringing the full cycle to matches in the future!

We’ve added 30+ new bugs and fish to discover across the island, with some only available during day or night! Good luck tracking them all down. Thankfully, the Museum staff have some new tools to help with completing your collections...

Introducing Fish Food and Bug Detectors! These new utility items can be purchased with Carl Coins from Museum staff members stationed around the Social Hub and carried in a new utility slot in your inventory.
Fish Food can be thrown into fish pools to make fish bite and respawn faster for everyone fishing there.
Bug Detectors reveal nearby rare-or-higher bugs, show how far away they are and how much longer they’ll be available. Indicators are shared with everyone in your party too!
Both tools make collecting with friends more active and engaging, while helping everyone fill out their collections!

To learn more about how the new tools work, visit Tantalus the Super Moth at the Museum of Super Natural History and Berryessa the Super Raccoon at Super Sea Land to start their new quests. Accomplished collectors will also find additional new quests from Wild Bull Hickok and Nibbles.

Thomas Sledison has been working on the long-requested burst rifle and is proud to unveil the Bullpup, a gun with enough bite to match its bark! He wanted to call it the DAUG, but the SAW higher-ups decided that was one pun too far.
The Bullpup fires in three-round bursts, making it ideal for mid to long-range combat, and holds 21 rounds per clip. Scoping in using the creep button also provides a small zoom.

The Bullpup can be found in Common, Uncommon, and Rare versions across all game modes, with an epic tier exclusive to the Tier 2 Merc class in SvR, and will take over the daily weapon rotation slot until Tuesday, July 21st.

Uzis & Dualzis are graduating into the permanent weapon pool! They were among our best-received rotating weapons, so they now have kill tracking and a full set of milestone skins alongside some balance adjustments (detailed below) to better define their role in the full lineup.

We’ve made several balance changes to better define each weapon’s role, with a particular focus on our rotating weapons. As the weapon roster continues to grow, we’ll keep looking for more ways to expand their availability.
The range of Uzis and Dualzis has been reduced by approximately 22%, positioning them more clearly between shotguns and the SMG.
X-Ray Cannon now uses 3 Superite ammo per shot and no longer breaks armor, but still deals damage through it.
Blunderbuss reload time has been reduced from 1.8s to 1.5s.
Bwoking Launcher ammo capacity has been increased to 6, and time between shots reduced from 0.50s to 0.45s.

SAW vs. Rebellion has received new additions and improvements thanks to all the feedback you shared when we asked what you’d like to see next! We received more great ideas than we could fit into one update, including some that would need more time and a larger SvR refresh, so we’re keeping those in mind for the future and you can keep the feedback coming.

A new class has entered the rotation: Merc! You’ll spawn with a randomized loadout drawn from rotating weapons and others that don’t normally appear in SvR, with possibilities including the Bullpup, Dualzis, Bwoking Launcher, X-Ray Cannon, and Blunderbuss. With so many different combinations, you’ll need to adapt your strategy to whatever equipment you’re dealt!

Each class now has its own helmet, making them easier to identify at a glance. The helmets are also shown on the class selection screen, alongside how many of your teammates are playing as each class.
Bot improvements were one of the most popular requests, so we’ve adjusted how they rotate between and defend flags:
Bots stick around flags while a teammate is capturing them.
Bots that capture a flag will remain there and defend it for a short time.
Some bots will visit team-owned flags more often and hold their position there briefly.

Changing classes no longer resets your progress toward tier 2, so you can switch more freely and even have tier 2 upgrades ready to activate across multiple classes at once. Each upgrade can still only be activated once before you’ll need to earn it again.
The chat box on PC/Mac has been redesigned to make it easier to keep up with your squad and team, and, for the first time, chat with your Discord friends without leaving the game!

To enable Discord DMs and friend invites, open BananOS, select the Social button in the top right, and sign into Discord from the Discord tab. You’ll then be able to message Discord friends directly from SAR and receive their replies in dedicated in-game DM tabs.
New Chat Feed and DM tabs make it easier to switch between All, Squad, and direct messages, with more messages visible at once and cleaner formatting
DM conversations are remembered throughout your play session and can be closed individually with a mouse or controller

Once Discord is linked, DMs from all your Discord friends appear in SAR chat by default. In Settings, you can limit incoming Discord DMs to conversations started from SAR or Discord friends you’ve messaged during that session, keeping unrelated conversations hidden.
If you'd like to prevent all Discord DMs from appearing in SAR while keeping Discord friend invites enabled, open the Discord app and go to Content & Social > Connected Games.

releases.displayName: Bright Future Update: A meteor strikes, shaking up Super Animal World

items.text: No need to keep counting down: the Bright Future Update has landed! A Banananite meteorite has crash-landed on the island, kicking off a new storyline with fresh quests, new weapons and mechanics, and a bunch of community-requested improvements. Here’s the quick rundown before we dive into the full patch notes:
A Banananite meteorite has landed in Super Animal World, bringing new NPCs, storylines, and quests
Banan Altars have popped up in Animal Royale, where offerings of bananas and Giant Emus can reward you... or punish you
The new X-Ray Cannon, Uzi, and dual-wieldable Dualzis arrive, along with a new featured weapon rotation system to keep matches feeling fresh
Hot Mode, Play Again, Auto-Accept Queue, and a Customize search bar are just some of this update’s community-requested improvements
The all-new Bright Future Pass and Bright Future Starter Pack bring the season’s retro-future sci-fi theme to life
Respawning Day returns with three weeks of eggs, challenges, rewards, and the new Super Cloud Skunk
New Super Gorilla, Super Chimpanzee, and “Alien” breeds are now available in the Research Lab
Four new Super Animals are also available for a limited time through Twitch Drops

Lots more is packed in too, including the new Swampwater Breezeway Hamsterball Racing track, Banana Crabs, shop updates, and plenty of updates to gameplay, Social Hub and UI (plus a Makeship plush tease)
If you’d rather watch the highlights, here’s our Developer Overview:
Now, let’s dive into everything packed into the Bright Future Update.

notes.title: A Meteorite Has Landed in Super Animal World!

items.text: Northeast of SAW Labs, a huge meteorite has landed, and the island’s factions have very different ideas about what it means.

The meteorite contains a strange, vibrant new material called Banananite. Thomas Sledison is eager to mine as much of it as he can for weapons development in his workshop, convinced it could lead to all kinds of wonderful, dangerous new inventions. The Cult of Banan, meanwhile, believes the Banananite meteorite is something much more sacred, and the yellow, softly-curved shape of its fragments does seem to suggest there may be something to their devotion.

They’re not the only ones captivated by it. The Super Simian Space Society has sprung up in response, an earnest new space-enthusiast club founded by two Super Apes, Ham and Enos, who are convinced the meteor points toward a bright future for Super Animal-kind among the stars.

Embark on new NPC storylines and quests by talking to Ham & Enos, Thomas Sledison, and the Deacon of Banan. Whether you’re helping a would-be space society win official recognition, testing Sledison’s latest experiments, or uncovering the mysteries of Banananite itself, there’s plenty to dig into.

notes.title: A-peel to a Higher Power: Banan Altars

items.text: Since the meteorite crashed down, mysterious Banan Altars have been reported popping up around the island. Built from fragments of sacred Banananite and awaiting tribute, they can be found during Animal Royale matches in solos, duos, and squads.

According to some, offerings of bananas and even Giant Emus may reward the faithful, though worshippers should also beware of punishments. Large offerings can reward powerful weapons, and those gifts come with a twist: bananafied weapons that send slippery bananas flying mid-fight. Praise Banan, but worship at your own risk.

notes.title: The Bright Future Pass Has Landed

items.text: The Bright Future Pass celebrates the meteor’s arrival while bringing the update’s retro-future sci-fi theme to life, with the Mini Rhino, Moonwalk emote, and loads of cosmetics inspired by classic sci-fi.
During this season, the Bright Future Pass is available at a discounted price of 550 SAW Tickets.
As always, Animal Passes never expire. You can keep working on passes you already own on your second track, or pick up older ones from The Archive for 750 SAW Tickets.

notes.title: New Weapons: Uzi, Dualzis, and the X-Ray Cannon

items.text: Time to spray and pray: the Uzi has arrived as a faster, wilder, and more close-quarters version of the SMG! Plus, if you find two Uzis, you can dual wield them to make an extra-chaotic pair of Dualzis.

The Uzi and Dualzis are also part of a new featured weapon rotation. After Respawning Day, this featured slot will rotate daily between the Uzi and Dualzis, the Blunderbuss, and the Bwoking Launcher to keep gameplay fresh. As we add more limited-time weapons in the future, we expect that lineup to grow too.

The X-Ray Cannon has also arrived as our first limited-time Mole Crate weapon! It uses Superite ammo and deals 100 damage when fully charged, or 50 through armor. Shots can pierce up to 3 enemies, with damage falling off after each hit.

Sneaking while holding the X-Ray Cannon will enter x-ray vision mode, letting you see through walls and track down where other players are hiding. Be careful, though: x-ray vision slows you down and makes a distinct sound that nearby players can hear.
We’ll be keeping a close eye on how the X-Ray Cannon plays, so let us know what you think. Depending on the response, we may tweak it or bring it back again in the future!

Hot Mode is here! Every 24 hours, one game mode will be marked as the day’s Hot Mode. For the first 5 matches you play in that mode, you’ll get an extra 25% XP! And don’t worry too much if you get eliminated early; you’ll always get a minimum 100 XP from completing a Hot Mode match.

Our goal with Hot Mode is to encourage fuller lobbies in the featured mode each day with a small bonus, while still keeping it optional. It’s something we’ll be monitoring, and we’d love to hear your thoughts on how it’s working so far and any similar features you’d like to see in future updates.

We’ve also added some of the community-requested improvements we’ve been hearing about a lot from all of you, aimed at making both core modes and the Social Hub smoother to move between and easier to navigate.

Play Again lets party hosts requeue everyone automatically once the group returns to the hub so you can re-queue right away without opening the modes screen. You can also cancel it by opening the Game Modes screen. Note: the spectate button has moved to the bottom right of the endgame screen, and can still also be triggered with the escape key.

Auto-Accept Queue is here and enabled by default, with a 10-second cancel window to make it easy to finish up what you’re doing while avoiding a missed match. If you prefer the old manual queue flow, you can switch back to it in the Game Modes screen.
We’ve finally added a Search bar to Customize and Emotes at MTN stations! With over 2,000 cosmetic items in the game, this is a really nice and long-requested addition.
The BananOS Social screen now includes Recent and Nearby players to make it easier to add friends, report, or mute.
It’s now easier to join friends’ Social Hubs directly from their profile (it works bi-directionally, not just for party hosts).
There are plenty more improvements and new features listed below as well, and we still have lots more planned for BananOS in future releases. Keep the feedback coming and we’ll keep refining it!

notes.title: Respawning Day Is Back With 3 Weeks of Challenges

items.text: Rejoice and Respawn! The Respawning Day event has begun, our holiday celebrating spring, eggs, and the miracle of clone-based functional immortality. Plus, free eggs on the ground.

From now until Friday, April 24th, colorful Super Eggs are hidden around the island. You can pick them up for a small heal, and you’ll also earn them by completing matches in any mode. Fabergé Giant Emu Eggs have popped up too, and smashing or shooting them will get you the prizes inside.
New challenge sets will unlock each week, so check back here or on social media to see what’s new. Once they unlock, you’ll have until the end of the event to complete them all!
Week 1 is live now, and here’s what you can unlock right away:
Easter Egg Pullover | Collect Super Eggs (1000)
1500 XP | Smash Fabergé Giant Emu Eggs (7)
Eggshell Umbrella | Banana Slip an Enemy

Super Cloud Skunk (Available at Level 20)

For the first 48 hours of the update, Banana Crabs will be swarming the beaches in a slippery April Fools frenzy. Watch your step, because touching them will make you slip! After the frenzy ends, Banana Crabs will remain in the Social Hub as a permanent new catchable bug, but at a much rarer Legendary tier.
As always, new Super Animal breeds introduced during events stay permanently available in the Research Lab, so unlocking them isn’t time-sensitive. Happy egg hunting!

Respawn Tank respawn timers have been adjusted. Respawning one teammate now takes 9 seconds, two teammates take 11 seconds, and three teammates take 13 seconds (previously, it always took 9 seconds regardless of how many players were being respawned).

Accordingly, the number of teammates respawned is now based on how many vials you’ve collected when you start the respawn. Picking up a new teammate vial during the respawn will not add that player to the current respawn, so you’ll need to cancel and restart it to include them, or find another Respawn Tank.
Respawn Tank cooldown has also been increased from 10s to 20s. These changes aim to make Respawn Tanks riskier when attempting larger comebacks and more difficult to use in rapid succession.
The first 5 shots after spinning up the Superite Laser now have no recoil, as suggested by Bloop on Discord. This makes it a more predictable burst weapon when fired in short bursts.
Respawn Tank icons now show on the map in duos and squads.

Loot now visually fades after a short delay when a player or placed banana is behind it. This helps prevent edge cases where certain emotes or Super Animal breeds let players hide too well in loot piles.

A new setting has been added to always show weapon skin effects, and it’s on by default. This lets everyone hear custom gun sounds like the Soil Revolver’s and see custom projectiles like the Cardinal Bow & Sparrow’s.

Lightning effect brightness has been decreased by 50% and duration has been increased from 1.8s to 2 seconds.

There’s also a new setting available to disable these charge indicator dots if you prefer the regular recoil indicators. For controller users, disabling them will show the old static indicators instead.

Weapons that don't reload such as the Bow & Sparrow and X-Ray Cannon will now show a single ammo label on the UI. This makes it clear that they don't need to reload and fixes edge cases such as a “0” being displayed in the current ammo text.

releases.displayName: A meteor lands March 31st with the Bright Future Update

items.text: A meteor is hurtling toward Super Animal World, and it lands Tuesday, March 31st with the Bright Future Update (v2.1)! It’s the first major update after Super Animal World (v2.0), bringing community-requested features and plenty of polish to the new systems.
The Banananite meteor’s impact kicks off a new storyline with new quests, new characters, and a retro-future sci-fi theme across the season and the Bright Future Pass.

We're also giving battle royale some extra love after all the cozy content in Super Animal World, with new weapons like the X-Ray Cannon, Uzis, and Dualzies, plus Banan Altars for rare loot (or curses). In the Research Lab, you can unlock new Super Animals, from bio-engineered “Alien” breeds to space-ready Super Gorillas and Chimps.

v2.1 also brings community-requested improvements for smoother matchmaking with Play Again + Auto-Accept Queue, Hot Mode (a featured mode each day gives bonus XP), and easier ways to join friends’ Social Hubs. There’s also, at long last, a search bar in Customize!
See you on the island, Super Animals!

The Pixile team is still hard at work on the Super Animal World expansion, which we’re now aiming to release in winter (...or whenever it’s ready), but we have a big bundle of surprises to share with you today as thanks for your patience!

By popular request, today we’re dropping one more Animal Pass, inspired by community requests from over the years. The By Popular Request Pass is our way of saying thank you to all of you in our amazing community of more than twelve million players. And, because we’re now back to self-publishing and thus free to make dumb business decisions, we’re making it a proper thank you by making it completely FREE to claim until Super Animal World arrives.

We’ve also made a few quality of life improvements to the game, added new Super Animal breeds, and are kicking off an end of summer celebration in our first self-published patch since returning to full independence, so check out the video below or read on for all the details.

The By Popular Request Pass is packed with cosmetics inspired by the community, and is FREE to claim throughout Season 11! Highlights of this pass include the Idol, Plague Doctor, and Trashcan Outfits, as well as the super-cute (and spiky) Mini Bearded Dragon pet and the Shy emote.

The new Super Animal World Supporter Pack DLC includes 3 unique Super Animal breeds, 12 cosmetics, and 750 tickets, and is available for those who want to support the expansion’s development and get a taste of Super Animal World themed items early.
Catch some final sun rays before fall during the Super End of Summer Royale event. It runs for three weeks and kicks off today with challenges, rewards, and fruity new Super Animal breeds each week!
Six additional new Super Animal breeds have been released from the Labs, with designs inspired or suggested by community members, just like the Animal Pass!
We’ve also made quality of life gameplay improvements and patched some bugs to improve player experience, including some significant changes to how the Zip-and-Go works.

Don’t miss the first sneak peek of Super Animal World gameplay in the video above too! We’re really proud of how fishing, bug catching and hamsterball racing are shaping up and we can’t wait to share more about the expansion in the coming months.

Join Catbaux, Kaity, Logan, and Michael for a special Pixile Plays tomorrow, Wednesday September 25th from 11am to 1pm PDT as they talk about the new update, Super Animal World, and answer your burning questions!

We typically stream every other week on Fridays at 11am PDT, so even if you can’t make it for this stream, you can follow the channel to get a notification when we go live in the future. With the By Popular Request Update out, we’re super excited to start sharing more about Super Animal World with everyone.
When deploying a zip-line, you’ll immediately begin riding it at maximum speed, opening up new ways to use it for mobility. Max speed is also a whole lot faster!
You’ll also get a speed boost each time you hop between zip-line segments in a chain of existing Zip-and-Go lines.
Each boost adds to your overall momentum and five chained rides on average-length lines will bring you to maximum speed.
The Ninja Booties powerup still provides a speed boost while riding a zip-line, but the maximum speed has the same cap.
Holding a Zip-and-Go now provides a zoom-out effect of 15% to help with placing them vertically (and spot incoming enemies).
New visuals and sound effects have also been added when chain riding between zip-lines!

The Super Juicer powerup has been removed (for now). Our philosophy for powerup design is for each powerup to have a clear niche that doesn’t overlap with others. It’s also important that powerups don’t have too many effects, and that those effects are reflected in their visual design. The Juicer just wasn’t carving out its own niche well enough, but you can still find a broken one in the Animal Pass as a gravestone! We’re planning to make further adjustments to the powerup system in the future too.
The Bandolier powerup now grants 10% faster reload speed in addition to its other effects. This includes the Hunting Rifle, which we feel should make for some exciting plays!

Lucky Cat Mines can no longer be set off by teammates (and they still do not damage teammates). This change should open up more strategic uses for mines, as well as just avoiding teammates mistakenly tripping them.
A new animation has been added for when Lucky Cat Mines are activated, making them more lively and visible before exploding, and fixing a visual issue when placed on conveyor belts.
SMOMA’s gallery has been updated with the pieces from the “Land, Sky, and Sea” Fanart Contest! You can view all of the amazing submissions on the fanart contest site: artcontest.animalroyale.com

Bots will de-prioritize targeting downed players, especially if other enemies are nearby to attack instead. This change only applies to human players though, so they’ll still thirst other bot teams. Those tryhards.
BCG egg projectiles are now affected by bullet speed modifiers (from private match commands or Mystery Mode).
Swapping your equipped weapon no longer cancels actions like healing, taping, reviving teammates, emoting, etc.
The snowy bridges in Thomas’ Tundra will now fade if a player is hiding behind them.
Removed Modus splash logo. We’re fully indie and self-publishing again!

Implemented better highlighting on text-fields and improved controller navigation to enter and exit typing. We published this change on PC in v1.9.3 but the change is now also reflected in the console versions.

We’ve made some behind-the-scenes changes on the backend for how Animal Pass items are claimed to support larger inventories. You shouldn’t notice anything from the change, but let us know if you have any issues when redeeming your items!
The Flamberge melee weapon was made a bit thicker.
Added /ziplines command for private matches to block access to ziplines.
Sub-admins in private matches can now open the leaderboard and type after death, which also allows them to use the /score command for leaderboard printout.

Fixed ammo and other loot dropping far away when on Beaver Construction HQ bridges.
Fixed an issue which caused loot to spawn over walls when dropped (particularly in shipping containers).
Fixed a bug where the last zombie kill in the Bwoking Dead did not count towards XP gain.
Fixed Z-order glitch on Super Bat wings.
Reduced visual recoil while shooting the Superite Laser.
Improved torso/body textures turning with the Super Animal’s body.

Matched the Blue Beanie’s position to match other colored beanies.
Improved arm bending in the SARturday Night Fever emote.
Added custom deformation to sleeves while parachuting to improve bending.

That’s all for the By Popular Request update! We hope you all have a ton of fun with the new content, and thank you so much again for all of your patience and support as the team works hard on the next big chapter of Super Animal Royale. We can’t wait to share more about the Super Animal World expansion with you as we continue development on it. See you on the island, Super Animals!

notes.title: Peace on Earth is Overrated: It’s CRISPRmas

items.text: As winter arrives, Super Animal World is ready to celebrate everything CRISPRmas means to its Super inhabitants: friendship, generosity, peace (for now), and most importantly, the miracle of genetic modification! The event includes:
3 new Super Animal breeds
15 challenges to complete with 9 new event cosmetics
20 legacy cosmetics return from previous CRISPRmas events
This year’s event functions differently from past years, with challenges to complete to earn the rewards. Here’s how it works:

When each week begins, a set of five weekly challenges will unlock for you to complete, with three of these challenges awarding you with the event’s new cosmetic items. Once each week’s challenges have unlocked, you’ll have until the event ends to complete them and earn their rewards.
Each week also debuts a new festive Super Animal breed in the Research Lab! As always, the animals are permanent additions so there’s no time limit to unlock them!
Candy canes are scattered around the map to consume for a small healing effect and to count towards some of your challenges.
Snowmen (or are they snowanimals?) have been built around Thomas’ Tundra! You can smash them to get some candy canes, and some of the event’s challenges will require you to destroy them.
We’ve got three weeks of gifts to unwrap this CRISPRmas, so check back for new Steam news posts each week with the debut of a new Super Animal breed and challenges!

The Super Sea Land gift shop now has animated screens.

Adjusted conveyors so bananas don't spin in circles on the corners. Sorry little dudes, no free rides.
Fixed a shadow sometimes appearing for broken hamster balls.
Fixed a bug where breaking different types of destructible objects would only play the sound of one type.
Fixed duplicated sounds when eating multiple things on an emu.
The emoting while parachuting bug should be fixed.
Fixed a bug where swapping to a weapon just after dropping it (while at higher ping) would leave the character stuck on the dropped weapon.
Fixed vertical flicker issue with controllers and petting mini animals.
Players spawning far in the skunk gas in the Bwoking Dead should be fixed now.

notes.title: Celebrate SAR’s 5th Anniversary and Big Things Ahead in 2024

items.text: To celebrate Super Animal Royale’s 5th anniversary with us, enter code BIRTHDAY to get 4 items:
Pixile Anniversary Firework melee weapon
Pixile Umbrella

The new Super Piñata Donkey has also arrived in the Research Lab in time for the party, but the Lab Labs asked me to advise you against trying to find out if there’s candy inside: this piñata fights back.

It’s crazy to think of how far Super Animal Royale has come since its Early Access debut half a decade ago on December 12th, 2018, and we can’t wait to share all the big things we have in the works for its sixth year.

But before we look forward, we’d be remiss not to also look back and celebrate the exciting year we’ve shared with all of you. This year marked the first Respawning Day and the new event system for Howloween, the first marine Super Animals and Super Sea Land, the Photo Booth feature, the game’s first-ever collab with Turnip Boy Robs a Bank, the Super Merch Shop and to top it all off, we officially crossed the 10 million total player mark this summer.

We’re so proud of what we’ve built and that so many of you enjoy playing it, and as big as 2023 has been, we can’t wait to make 2024 even bigger. We couldn’t do any of this without all of you in the community, so from all of us at Pixile, thank you so much for your support in building this world together that we all love to spend time in.

Before we sign off for this update we wanted to give you a bit of a peek at some of what we have planned next for the game, but we’re saving the biggest surprises for next year. Here’s some of what’s coming up next after CRISPRmas concludes in the new year:
We can’t wait to share more of what we’ve been working on for 2024 when it’s ready, and in the meantime, we hope you have a ton of fun with the Dragon’s Loot Update and CRISPRmas!

notes.title: New in the SAW Shop & Carl’s Cart

items.text: Ms. Macawsome’s stock has expanded once again with a new bundle and emote! She’s always one to be improving her catalog… or would it be parrotalog?
Diner Bundle, including the Diner Server Dress, Hat, and Milkshake melee weapon
Hit the beach for an end-of-summer luau with the new Hula emote
We have three colors of party hats to watch out for in Carl’s Cart too that will be rotating in this week.

A soft matchmaking system has been implemented in the SAW vs Rebellion game mode. At the start of a match, teams are balanced based on player level for an improved and more balanced experience. This means you won’t get your helmet until the match begins and your team is assigned.
Scout I’s skunk bomb count has been reduced to 1, and Scout II’s to 3.

Teammates in the SAW vs Rebellion mode no longer trigger friendly Lucky Cat Mines. This will allow them to be more useful, as players often found them being accidentally detonated by allies in large-team modes.
The Wave emote is now a milestone reward, achieved by playing 20 team-based games.

The legendary BCG’s max damage has been lowered from 76 to 72. This will make it typically still able to two-shot players wearing level 1 armor, but now fairly unlikely to two-shot players wearing level 2 & 3 armor.
Common magnum damage at the muzzle has been increased from 51 to 53, and uncommon magnum damage has been increased from 54 to 55. This keeps them more in line with the rare magnum.
Up and down melee swings have been adjusted to occur within 40 degrees of north and south aim (previously, this was 30 degrees).
Throwables now make a sound while traveling mid-air to better alert players of their presence.
Sparrow trackers can now apply to Giant Emus.
Removed local rollback upon death, so higher ping players don't feel like they are teleported after dying.
While dead, the chat field will now show a message about not being able to type (and block text input) for all-chat.
Added creep (walk) and creep (idle) to the photo booth.
Exclamation alert badges that notify about Photo Booth Scenes that are earned now appear on the main menu and the Photo Booth tab.
Added a support code option for email-linked players in Manage Account.
Many changes have been made to the game’s bots to improve the player experience, especially for newer players.
Bots aim more smoothly, making them more realistic in how they look around, and with fewer abrupt snaps.
Bot aim has more randomization now.
Pursuit range, aim, and vision have been reduced against lower level players (below level 40).
Fixed hunting rifle bots shooting too quickly.
Bots will roll less while pursuing players under level 20.
If targeting a downed player, bots will look for new enemies in line of sight that are not downed to prioritize before the downed player.
Lowered attack speed of bots slightly.
Carry/place limit is now 4 (6 with bandolier).
Zip-and-Go throwables now spawn in the world as packs of two rather than individually.
Deployment animation has been lowered from 0.50s to 0.39s.
Drone speed is 30% faster.
Increased minimum exit time after riding, to reduce spam clicks causing accidental exit.
Server predicts exit position and waits based on player ping to avoid players seeing themselves stuck in water.
Private match hosts now have a /weight command:
This command can be used to regenerate the loot table with various weapon spawn weightings, while in lobby.
Valid weight types include ‘all’, any gun class, any gun ID, and any grenade ID (with values from 0.0 to 5.0).
Priority is given to the most specific type, for instance ‘/weight all 0 gunhuntingrifle 1’ will allow for a match with only hunting rifles.
It is important to note that the weight value is a multiplier on the original weapon weight, so the minigun is still zero spawn chance in the world, even with a 5.0 weight.
Mole crates are not affected by weight but a weight of zero will stop a weapon from being in the drops.
Weight does affect rebel caches as well as grenades/bananas from grass and breakable crates.
For mystery mode, weights are applied after any mystery mode specific modifiers.
The command ‘/weight reset’ can be used to reset all weightings.

Private match hosts can also enter a ‘/mystery #’ command to change the Mystery Mode type in the lobby. One minor thing to note is that if picking Western mode, all player hats will change to a cowboy hat, but changing to another mystery type will not undo the hat.
Other functionalities have been added for private match hosts, as well:
Added ‘/kill all’ command for private match hosts.
Added ‘/nade’ command for private matches, to spawn grenades.
On PC, ‘/netdata’ command now shows packet loss.
Added animated jellyfish & water to some of the tanks at the Super Sea Land aquarium!
Added posts to many boardwalks around the map, especially at Super Sea Land.
Updated the shape of the sand islands at Super Sea Land.
Improved collisions at the aquarium by removing the rocky corals and removing collisions from tube corals.
The Sea Legs Restaurant’s side hut has been revamped.
Stage seating was updated at Super Sea Land so players can walk between rows. A barrier has also been added at the water's edge.
Improved rail visibility around the Super Sea Land stage.
Widened some door openings around Super Sea Land and added patios.
Adjusted Super Sea Land stage lights and added markings where the stage TVs fell in the animated YouTube short.
Crates near the broken saw mill line that blocked collisions abnormally have been moved.
Fixed some construction walls at Beaver HQ that were able to be hidden behind.
Fixed a corner of the houses at S.A.W. Villas that could be seen through.
Fixed upward melee swings not able to hit fences if right against them, and fixed downward swings sometimes not playing tree-hit sound.
Fixed phantom mole crate pulse appearing on the map if viewing it after the mole has left.
Fixed map being openable while the report panel is active.
Fixed the water at Nautitorium stage not being treated as water for throwables such as bananas.
Fixed z-order on Nautitorium rails especially with zip-lines.
Fixed pets sleep sound playing repeatedly in the fruit press if you died there at the end of the conveyor belt with a pet.
Fixed being able to board teammate emus through walls.
Fixed a bug where changing emus and eating a second speed mushroom would add the stacked effect to the second emu.
Fixed giant emu and your own mushroom speed boost timer getting mixed up when dismounting/remounting an emu while both boosts are active.
Healing emus no longer incorrectly contributes to the healing stat & milestone.
Fixed sparrow tracker position on player when riding a giant emu. Sparrow will also match the direction the player and emu are facing.
Fixed a bug where grenades and other throwables being tossed while becoming a Zombie Joe would end up stuck on the map.
Phantom respawn timer in the Bwoking Dead should be fixed now.
Fixed Zombie Joes spawning in the fruit press. Might have to recall those last few batches of juice…
Fixed a bug where changing to MP4 in the photo booth didn't do transparent checkbox toggling in one case.
Fixed friends in the Photo Booth not having their proper gem level after being duplicated.
Fixed gem emote flipping the gem upside down in the photo booth.
Fixed controller bug with navigation on the Customize emote tab not showing an emote when using dpad-left.
Fixed random vertical flickering for controller users when drinking or taping.
Can no longer change the fill toggle while matchmaking (prevents desync bug).

notes.title: Big Things Coming to Super Animal World

items.text: We also wanted to take this opportunity to share a little bit of what you can look forward to next in Super Animal Royale, after the update.

You might have noticed that this season is a little more focused on quality of life improvements, seasonal content and new animals than our previous update, and that’s because we’re working on something really big for Super Animal Royale in parallel. We’re super excited about it, but we’re not quite ready to talk about it yet aside from that you can look forward to it coming in 2024.

In the meantime, we’ve packed the schedule for the rest of 2023. After this update and the Turnip Boy event, you’ll be able to look forward to Howloween and CRISPRmas in the brand new event format, another update in December, and lots of additional surprises sprinkled in between.
We’re very excited for all the big things coming in SAR’s future, and we hope you’ll all have a ton of fun this season with the Party Animal update and the Turnip Boy collab event.
We’ll see you all at the party, Super Animals!

items.text: With the long-anticipated release of aquatic Super Animals, a nautical new point of interest, zip-lines, a new weapon, and more, there’s a whole lot of ground - er… sea to cover, so let’s dive right in.
The Sea Legs Pass celebrates upright marine life with a wide range of Super Sea Land inspired items and the coveted Sip emote and Mini Otter pet.
The Season 8 Starter Pack is now available, featuring the Super Cartoon Fennec Fox.
Super Fish and Super Dolphins have arrived as the island’s first aquatic combatants, with 11 total breeds to unlock between them.

Super Sea Land is the largest and most ambitious new location in years with an Aquarium, Nautitorium, and Sea Legs restaurant to explore, connected by zip-lines. We’ve even created a limited edition tee for it on the Super Merch Shop that you can check out below!
The new Zip-And-Go throwable can be deployed anywhere to get you over gaps, and connect with other zip-lines.
The Superite Laser, a superite-powered laser blasting cousin of the minigun, has been released from Thomas’s Workshop!
The Super Summer Royale event is live for the next 3 weeks, with new event cosmetics and 2 new Super Animal Breeds: the Super Apricat and Super Banana Dog!
Tons more gameplay and sound improvements to read about below including a complete overhaul of melee attacks with a 3-strike sequence.

Before we dig into everything in the update we also just wanted to thank you all for helping us hit a massive milestone. We’ve officially crossed 10 million unique players who have played Super Animal Royale!

Your constant excitement, love and support through this journey means so much to us, and it can still be hard to believe how far we’ve come as a small indie team. We’re so proud of what we’ve built with all of you, and hope you have a ton of fun with this update.

notes.title: See You At Super Sea Land!

items.text: Built around Super Animal Bay on the island’s Southeast corner, Super Sea Land is one of the island’s largest locations, containing three significant points-of-interest:
The Super Animal Bay Aquarium is a hypnotic warren of towering fish tanks, many of which have been smashed open for land-based fighting to flow through them.
The Sea Land Nautitorium is an outdoor amphitheater where guests floated in pools watching Super Dolphins perform on land.
The Sea Legs restaurant once allowed guests a chance to taste a genetically crafted delicacy found only in the park.
Zip-lines crossing Super Animal Bay allow for fast travel within the area, and sand bars provide even more looting opportunities between the buildings.

notes.title: Limited Edition Super Sea Land Tee

items.text: We haven’t figured out the logistics of opening a real Super Sea Land yet, but at least we can make the shirts!
We designed the Super Sea Land Visitor Tee to celebrate the grand opening of Super Sea Land, and it was inspired by the in-game Super Sea Land Visitor Outfit that you can earn in the Sea Legs Pass.
Get it in the Super Merch Shop, while supplies last!

There are several new permanent zip-lines around the map to discover beyond those found at Super Sea Land! They create new shortcuts over bodies of water, including a particularly long line east of Superite Mountain.
The beaches, rivers, dam, swamp, and Welcome Center fountain all have new animated water effects.
The forest and beach area above Pixile Port has been expanded.
The top left corner of SAW Security HQ’s barracks has a new opening.
New paths have been added throughout the island’s grassy forests to better link parts of the environment and guide players through them.
A pillar has been removed from bungalow houses to link paths up to their entrances properly.

Unlike the new permanent zip-lines that can also be found around the park, these zippy throwables can be placed wherever you want. Throwing them works similarly to a grenade, but deploys a usable zip-line via a small drone that flies to where you’re aiming.

You can make paths across water and over small objects using this, but be careful - you’ll have your hands busy while riding and can’t shoot! You’ll exit the zip-line upon reaching a node, or you can press the interact button to jump off, so long as you’re above ground you can stand on.
Zip-lines can be linked together to extend their length. You can ride along multiple nodes continuously by pressing in the direction of the next line you want to ride.
Collect and deploy up to 3 Zip-and-Go lines (or 4 with the Bandolier powerup).
Ninja Booties give a 15% faster zip-line travel speed while equipped.
If you run out of health while on a zip-line, you’ll end up in a downed or dead state upon reaching the end of the line.
A new daily challenge has been added for riding zip-lines!
And just because we know some of you will try it: you cannot squish someone with a hamster ball while they’re riding on a zip-line.

The newest paragon of Super Animal technology has been released from Thomas’ Workshop: the Superite Laser! This charge-up light machine gun fires beams of superite at an astounding rate. Its low damage per shot and high recoil compensate for its frenzied firing speed.
The Superite Laser uses superite cartridges for ammo, which can be found by breaking special new superite crates found around the map, and the gun itself can be found in uncommon and rare varieties.
All of the regular kill milestones for colored weapon skins have been added for this new gun, and it also has its own entry for kills on the stats screen.

notes.title: Cool Off with the Super Summer Royale event

items.text: 2023’s Super Summer Royale event has begun! Fruit has been scattered around the island to collect, redeemable for 8 new event-exclusive cosmetics. A wave of legacy items has also returned from past Super Summer Royale events. Some can be earned in the event using fruit and some have made their way into Cackling Carl’s Cart.
The Super Summer Royale Event runs from July 11th to August 1st.
Two new sweet breeds of Super Animals are available in the Research Lab, too: the Super Apricat and Super Banana Dog!

notes.title: Pillage Some New SAW Shop Swag

items.text: Before you ask, no, Ms. Macawsome will NOT stand on your shoulder.
The Pirate Bundle is available for purchase in the SAW Shop! Remind those landlubbers that the sea’s not all fun and games with the included cosmetics:
Pirate Dress outfit
Pirate Bandana hat
Black Flag melee weapon
Flintlock magnum skin

We have two more new SAW Shop items that are also currently available this week: the Monkey Dance emote and Water Pistol skin! More brand-new SAW Shop items will be rotating into the shop over the coming weeks as well, so keep an eye out.

We’ve completely overhauled how melee attacks work in SAR to make them feel more dynamic, and we can’t wait to hear what you think of the new mechanics! Attacking with your melee now initiates a directional combo of 3 different swings, with the third, circular strike gaining increased hit radius.

In the previous system, swinging your melee weapon used to slow you down similar to firing a gun. Now, when you swing you'll actually get a slight boost in speed, faster than your regular walking rate. It's not as fast as Super Jump Rolling, but it's a big help in chasing down foes when you're stuck without a gun.

In the Bwoking Dead game mode, Zombie Joes also get this directional improvement and have a new attack animation, however they do not cycle through different swing types since they’re not armed with a melee weapon.

This overhaul aims to make attacking with your melee weapon a better, more fluid option in close quarters if you don’t manage to snag a weapon early game, or if you run out of ammo, and it also makes chopping grass and breaking crates feel much better while looting.

notes.title: Listen Up - New Audio Effects and Improvements

items.text: SAR’s gotten a ton of audio overhauls this update to improve the auditory experience! Here’s some changes to keep an ear out for:
Most character-related sounds and emotes now use stereo audio. This improves the quality and depth of many sounds that were previously only played in mono.
Added stereo spread to environmental music (for example, the stage shows and water fountain).

Updated the sound for using Super Tape so it provides a more distinct ending to mark completion. Also, a bug where the tape sound effect could play multiple times if pressed quickly at higher pings has been fixed.
Impossible Tape has a new taping sound (sounds more super!)

Added a new spatial hit impact sound for when enemy players are hit. This sound plays immediately when you hit another player (client side), while the original 'ding' hit sound will still also play when the server confirms the hit & damage.
Updated enemy player hit sounds to be louder and more reactive sounding.
Less important sounds will now have audio levels ducked if important sounds are triggered (ie hits, grenade landing, squadmate knocked).
Fixed player hit sounds triggering multiple times in one frame.
Fixed hamster ball hit sounds triggering multiple times in one frame.
Self-damaging poison no longer plays the sound for an enemy player being hit.
Waterfalls in close proximity no longer play identical audio clips, which caused audio phasing issues
Sound added for the large screen at S.A.W. Security HQ.
Sound added to the fish tanks at Penguin Palace.
Added a specific sound for breaking the wood blockades at S.A.W. Security HQ.

Be sure to stop by Super Sea Land to enjoy some of the new tracks too, especially the Aquarium’s ambiance track! We’ve been excited to share it with you, as it’s quickly become one of our favorites. That Jake guy really knows what he’s doing.
Kill milestones for the Superite Laser have been added, as mentioned above.

New win milestones have been added for reaching the Top of the Food Chain, along with new cosmetics as rewards! These are the Royal Scepter melee weapon at 50 wins, and the King’s Outfit at 100 wins (Super Edition required to claim).
A new milestone has been added for becoming the unfortunate victim of a Health Juice Factory production accident. Hopefully its reward is suitable workman’s comp (Super Edition required to claim).
The most important change: you can now pet other player's Mini Animals in the lobby!
The gas radius of damaged Skunk Mushrooms has been increased from 15 to 20, and the number of total damage ticks has been increased from 13 to 14.
Minigun windup time is now 0.48s, down from 0.72s. This change aims to help the weapon become better equipped for a variety of situations and worth its legendary status.

The Super Juicer now increases your Health Juice maximum to 300, gives double the previous amount from juicing, and if you are at maximum juice it will produce lootable juice cans. Its style has also been updated.
Eggs from the BCG now properly check the height of downed players when calculating mid-air collisions.

Reworked object interaction so that the nearest interactable object will always take precedence. This prevents issues with zip-line boarding while loot is around, and fixes various other long-standing issues such as boarding Giant Emus inside loot piles.
In SvR mode, points are now only deducted for respawning if you died to another player.
Adjusted pet movement on conveyors so it can push them while idling.
If you eat a Speed Mushroom while already under its effects, the boost’s duration now stacks.
Quick chat pings on mushrooms now indicate the type.
Dart guns by default will now heal Giant Emus, since they are non-hostile creatures. However, they will still damage the emu if a rider is non-friendly.
Wins will now count towards the "Survive until the final gas circle" challenge.
Many improvements have been made behind the scenes regarding textures, sounds, characters, and code to reduce the total memory usage of SAR.
Several TV screens throughout the map (SART screen, Mini ranch ad screens, and so on) now use video as opposed to sprite sheets, which saves a lot of memory usage.
Blush and Black/White Warpaint are now equipped using the beard slot instead of glasses.
Players can now use the emote wheel in the main menu.
The Laugh emote's animation and sound has been adjusted to fit the tone of the game better and be used more generally.
The Customize screen now uses a recycling scroll rect so that players with large inventories will not have lag when changing tabs.
On the Challenges screen, you can click on the faded daily/weekly side to change tabs.
On PC, the Photo Booth can now save images and GIFs with transparency. This option is provided while on the green screen background.
Buying an archived Animal Pass now automatically switches to the progress tab and animates the pass into position.
The Steam Deck now uses floating keyboard input instead of the fullscreen keyboard.
Improved vignetting to scale with zoom while in private match ghost mode.
Added /noboss command for private matches to toggle whether the Giant Mole boss arrives or not in SvR.
SAR is now using Unity's incremental garbage collector, which should help prevent stutters that occur after long play sessions on lower end machines.
Added /netdata command on PC to show incoming and outgoing data rate.
Lucky Cat Mines will self-destruct if more than 4 are placed, beginning with the oldest mine. This was the original intended design, but it was not working due to a bug.
Fixed a bug where 2 people eating a blue mushroom at the same time would both see the speed effect.
Fixed Giant Emus not being able to peck health fruit.
Fixed Super Juicer sound playing when eating coconuts & mushrooms on a Giant Emu.
Fixed military tent geometry to no longer allow throwables through some corners.
Fixed emoting while slipping on a banana causing glitched character animations.
Squadmates who leave while in the lobby or disconnect mid-match will have their paw markers removed from the map.
Added a tiny start delay to most bullet trails which fixes some longstanding visual issues with bullets appearing through muzzles.
Fixed a soft crash if dropping your weapon at high ping and changing to that slot during that brief drop window.
Fixed a gem scale bug in the photo booth.
Fixed many death explosions that didn't scale up properly in the main menu.
Archive passes can now be reactivated if missing any claimed items, even if completed on experience.
Fixed credits being unopenable if the Esc key was pressed as it was opening.
Fixed a bug where controller users would see item reward popups on the Animal Pass screen, but have selection stuck on the pass itself.
Fixed the Research Lab’s tube showing the wrong Super Fox in certain cases when first going to the Research Lab tab.
Fixed a soft crash if going to the Research Lab tab before player data was loaded.
That’s all for the Sea Legs Update’s patch notes, Super Animals! Hope your battles go swimmingly. Take care and we’ll see you on the island!

items.text: The Super Peacocks have some colorful competition: the brand new Super Mandarin Duck has arrived and feels right at home in Season 5: Friends of a Feather!
